items.title: 'Biting' Man Duct-Taped To His Seat After Racist Abuse On American Airlines Flight
items.summary: Three passengers on an American Airlines flight from Dallas to Newark restrained a fellow traveler with zip ties and duct-taped him to his seat after he bit one of the men trying to hold him down. The 67-year-old man turned violent during a racist and homophobic tirade in the Domestic First Class cabin, assaulting two passengers and shouting slurs at a flight attendant.

items.title: The Aircraft That Could Save Regional Flying
items.summary: Tom Boon of Simple Flying sits down with ATR Chief Commercial Officer Alexis Vidal at the 2026 Farnborough Airshow to explore the future of regional aviation. From restoring lost air routes and identifying untapped demand through mobility data to premium cabin innovations and higher production targets, ATR outlines how it plans to reconnect communities and expand regional air travel worldwide.
